verdict.rationale: Cooley GO ships document-generator software, so a bulk-operations story is a fair question. The evidence does not show bulk operations across many items. The generators can produce 'any or all' documents in a single package from one set of inputs, and the S-1 tool updates one draft via prompts, but neither is a documented capability to act on many items, records or matters at once. No API exists to script bulk actions either: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
